# No Memory Between Calls {#sec-no-memory}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "it remembers me" — every call is stateless; memory is a
transcript you resend.

Installs: `Conversation`, the context window, token budgets, why long
chats get expensive and forgetful. Working build: a chat that
remembers your name, then `save()`/`load()` to show the memory is a
JSON file.
:::
